headline: Luzardo, Kilian blank Nationals as Phillies win 5-0
recap: Jesus Luzardo struck out seven over eight scoreless innings and Caleb Kilian closed it out with a scoreless ninth as the Phillies shut out the Washington Nationals 5-0 at Citizens Bank Park on Tuesday. Philadelphia scored a run in the first inning, three more in the third and an insurance run in the seventh. Trea Turner went 3-for-4 with two runs scored and an RBI, Luis Arraez drove in two with a double, Brandon Marsh doubled in a run and Alec Bohm added a sacrifice-fly RBI.
The shutout was Philadelphia's fourth straight win. The Phillies are 61-53, second in the NL East, 7.5 games behind the division-leading Atlanta Braves.

Philadelphia continues its series with Washington tonight at Citizens Bank Park, first pitch 6:40 PM ET. Andrew Painter starts for the Phillies against Nationals right-hander Jake Irvin. DraftKings has the Phillies as -168 moneyline favorites, -1.5 on the run line.
